name: Doty Ravine Preserve
description: Placer Land Trust preserve north of Lincoln, CA. Process-based restoration (beaver dam analogues + natural beaver recolonization) beginning ~2014 reconnected ~60 acres of floodplain along Doty Ravine, a tributary of Coon Creek.
notes: Center set on the preserve reach of Doty Ravine: 'off Gladding and Manzanita Roads, near Manzanita Cemetery' (cemetery at 38.9440, -121.3039 per OSM), stream at lat ~38.939 there. Verified against calibration frames 2025-Q3.
